summary: Test suite covers the happy-path workflow execution and validates workflow structure (YAML, actionlint, syntax checks) but has critical gaps: (1) Fixtures `fixtures/run1.xml` and `fixtures/run2.json` referenced throughout are not provided/shown, making fixture correctness unverifiable; (2) No unit tests for individual script subcommands (`parse`, `parse-junit`, `parse-json`, `summary`, `totals`) — all testing is indirect through a single act integration run; (3) No error scenario testing (malformed files, missing fields, invalid JSON/XML); (4) No edge case coverage (empty results, zero durations, format variations in status values like "pass" vs "passed", "ok", "error" vs "fail"); (5) All ~13 functional tests depend on one setup_file act run outcome, reducing independence and making tests fragile to fixture changes; (6) No negative tests or boundary condition checks. Workflow structure validation is reasonable but functional testing is shallow and integration-heavy.
